# Northwind Estate

> Northwind Estate is a premier low-density residential gated community in Sector 22D, Yamuna Expressway, Greater Noida, offering luxury 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments near the upcoming Noida International Airport (Jewar).

For the complete, in-depth technical knowledge base, full article texts, architectural specifications, and FAQ database, read the full knowledge file:
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://northwindyamunaexpressway.homes/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive 10,000+ word master reference document.
